node-1720195476327.name: MergeToTarget
node-1720195476327.sqlQuery:
MERGE INTO AwsDataCatalog.<your_curated_glue_catalog_db>.cds_ap_line_items t
USING (SELECT * FROM sdf) s on s.accountingdocument = t.accountingdocument AND s.companycode = t.companycode AND s.fiscalyear = t.fiscalyear AND s.ledgergllineitem = t.ledgergllineitem AND s.sourceledger = t.sourceledger 
WHEN MATCHED AND s.odq_changemode = 'D' THEN delete
WHEN MATCHED AND s.odq_changemode <> 'D' THEN UPDATE SET * 
WHEN NOT MATCHED AND s.odq_changemode <> 'D' THEN INSERT *

node-1722906262011.name: Select_Updated_Source_Data
node-1722906262011.code:
max_timestamp = spark.sql("""
        SELECT MAX(loadts) AS max_load_timestamp FROM AwsDataCatalog.<your_curated_glue_catalog_db>.cds_ap_line_items
    """).collect()[0]["max_load_timestamp"]
if max_timestamp is None:
    max_timestamp = "1970-01-01 00:00:00"
filtered_data = spark.sql(f"""
        SELECT *
        FROM AwsDataCatalog.<your_enriched_glue_catalog_db>.cds_gl_line_items
        WHERE ( accountingdocumenttype = 'KA' OR accountingdocumenttype = 'KG' OR accountingdocumenttype = 'KN' OR accountingdocumenttype ='KP' OR accountingdocumenttype = 'KR' OR accountingdocumenttype = 'KZ' ) AND loadts > cast('{max_timestamp}'as timestamp)  """)  
dyf = DynamicFrame.fromDF(filtered_data, glueContext, "filtered_data")
return DynamicFrameCollection({"Select_Updated_Source_Data": dyf}, glueContext)
